title: Slot masking and hashing template engine with neighbor count evaluation
body:
SLOT MASKING TEMPLATE ENGINE
- Introduced a high-speed slot masking and hashing template engine that matches parameterized natural-language questions in sub-millisecond time.
- Extracts and normalizes dynamic slots (entities, relations, numbers, comparisons) to evaluate AST plans deterministically without invoking language models.

COLLECTION LENGTH & NEIGHBOR COUNTS
- Added support for collection length evaluation in AST plans across Countrydle, Powiatdle, Województwodle, and US Statedle.
- Questions comparing neighbor counts (e.g. "does it border at least 4 countries/states?", "does it border more than 3 voivodeships?") evaluate instantly against local databases.
